blind.description: A rectangular carved stone sarcophagus or tomb with a heavy fitted lid. The lid features a central raised diamond relief and two transverse stone bands across its width. The main body has architectural moldings, corner pilasters, arched recessed panels with circular medallions on the short ends, and a row of small colonnades/pillars framing circular bosses along the long sides. Textures depict weathered, moss-stained green and brownish-grey stone. The geometry is solid and continuous with no hovering elements, cracks, or holes, resting flat on its integrated molded base.
blind.from_above: A rectangular stone lid framed by a recessed border, featuring a prominent vertical rhombus/diamond medallion in the center and two raised horizontal stone bands spanning across the width near the top and bottom edges.
blind.height_vs_figure: About half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 2.5 to 3 ft tall) and roughly 5 to 6 ft long by 2.5 ft wide.
